title: sesleria uliginosa f. subscabrida
intro: Sesleria uliginosa f. subscabrida, commonly known as Marsh Blue Fescue, is a plant species in the family Poaceae, characterized by its unique, blue-green foliage and slender stems. The health benefits of Sesleria uliginosa f. subscabrida include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities. While further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties, Sesleria uliginosa f. subscabrida has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its putative therapeutic effects.
